# Darragh Mahns

> Forward deployed engineer at Lattice Partners (AI consulting, not Lattice HR). Builds AI agents for non-technical companies and small businesses. Based in Missoula, MT. Pages and WebMCP tools on https://darraghmahns.com.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://darraghmahns.com/)
- [About](https://darraghmahns.com/about/)
- [Projects](https://darraghmahns.com/projects/)
- [Blog](https://darraghmahns.com/posts/)
- [Contact](https://darraghmahns.com/contact/)

## Tools

- [Open Send Message](https://darraghmahns.com): Installed. Open the page to Send Darragh Mahns a message using the contact form. Collect the visitor’s name, email address, and message.
- [Get Blog](https://darraghmahns.com): Installed. Look up Darragh Mahns’s blog article titles and publication dates, covering engineering projects, software, and related topics.
- [Read articles](https://darraghmahns.com): Suggested. Looks up information. Look up articles by Darragh Mahns, including titles and publication dates.
- [Send a message](https://darraghmahns.com/contact/): Suggested. Takes an action. Send a message to Darragh Mahns. Collect the visitor's name, email address, and message. Inputs: Name, Email, Message.
- [Read the blog](https://darraghmahns.com/posts/): Suggested. Looks up information. Find Darragh Mahns's blog posts about AI agents, engineering projects, and business software.
